#set document(title: "UDAY PRATAP SINGH PARIHAR")
#set page(paper: "us-legal", margin: (left: 0.65in, right: 0.65in, top: 0.55in, bottom: 0.55in))
#set text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 10pt, fill: rgb("#1A1F2B"))
#set par(leading: 0.55em, spacing: 0.55em, justify: false)

#let accent = rgb("#1D4ED8")
#let icon-color = accent
#let subtext = rgb("#374151")

#set list(indent: 0.15in, body-indent: 0.5em, marker: text(size: 0.72em)[#sym.bullet], spacing: 0.55em)

// Section header: vertically centered title underlined by a single blue rule.
#let sectionhead(title) = {
  v(12pt, weak: true)
  text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), fill: accent, weight: "bold", size: 12.5pt)[#upper(title)]
  v(4pt, weak: true)
  line(length: 100%, stroke: 0.6pt + rgb("#1D4ED8"))
  v(8pt, weak: true)
}

// Entry helper with vertical centering, matching jake's robust spacing.
#let entry(
  title-co,
  date,
  location: none,
  description: none,
  bullets: none,
) = block(
  above: 10pt,
  below: 0pt,
  width: 100%,
)[
  #grid(columns: (1fr, auto), align: (left, right), [#strong[#title-co]], [#date])
  #if location != none [
    #v(2pt)
    #text(size: 0.9em, fill: subtext)[#location]
  ]
  #if description != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #description
  ]
  #if bullets != none [
    #v(3pt)
    #bullets
  ]
]

#let skillblock(body) = block(above: 10pt, below: 0pt)[
  #body
]

#text(font: ("Liberation Sans", "Arial", "Helvetica Neue", "Helvetica", "Arimo"), size: 24pt, weight: "bold", fill: accent)[Uday Pratap Singh Parihar]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 10pt * 1.6, weight: "bold")[FULL STACK | AUTOMATION | REVERSE ENGINEERING]

#v(2pt)
#text(size: 0.9em)[#box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/location.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/phone.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) +91 8819923334 | #box(baseline: 20%, height: 0.9em, image(bytes(read("/packages/renderer/icons/email.svg").replace("<svg ", "<svg fill=\"" + icon-color.to-hex() + "\" ")), format: "svg")) #link("mailto:work@udayps.com")[work\@udayps.com]]

#sectionhead[Profile]
Full-stack developer focused on shipping production features and building efficient automation systems. Hands-on experience building LLM-powered products, developing agentic workflows, and reverse-engineering complex APIs to solve integration challenges. Comfortable with high-throughput systems and building reliable tools where documentation is limited. I enjoy digging into how systems work to deliver scalable, impactful solutions.

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Work Experience]
#entry([Founding Engineer, Delivo], [Jan 2023 --- Feb 2025], location: [Mumbai, Maharashtra, India], bullets: [
- Built a cutting-edge logistics web platform to streamline the management of international shipping operation,
- Owned the end-to-end tech stack, from platform architecture and core workflows to client/warehouse dashboards and system integrations.
- Collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure seamless integration with existing systems and compliance with international shipping regulations.
])
#entry([Software Engineer Intern, Tradyon], [May 2025 --- Jul 2025], location: [Bengaluru, Karnataka, India], bullets: [
- Delivered end-to-end product features for Tradyon's cross platform AI chatbot (Next.js web + React Native app).
- Shipped production features and bug fixes across web and mobile to improve chatbot UX and reliability.
- Built agentic workflows using Dify to orchestrate LLM interactions with global trade-data retrieval (BigQuery backed) and downstream response generation.
- Enabled rich responses (text + charts/graphs) by wiring workflows into the app's existing data/services layer.
- Worked in a fast iteration cycle, prioritizing delivery speed while maintaining code quality.
])

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Projects]
#entry([EHR Automation — eClinicalWorks], [Aug 2025], bullets: [
- Reverse engineered the platform's payload encryption of request endpoints to enable reliable automation.
- Built a custom API wrapper by analyzing network traffic and request/response patterns, enabling programmatic patient creation and appointment scheduling (UI-free integration layer).
])
#entry([E-commerce Automation — Myntra, Flipkart], [Dec 2023], bullets: [
- Built an automation suite with high volume account generation (500+), restock/price monitors, and a low-latency request-driven bulk checkout executor (~2s COD) at 500+ concurrency.
- Implemented a centralized web dashboard to manage accounts, orders, and delivery codes; deployed on GCP Cloud Run for scale.
- Integrated automated card payment flows with 3DS OTP capture/autofill via companion app integration to reduce manual intervention.
])
#entry([High-Concurrency Ticketing — BookMyShow], [Oct 2024 --- Nov 2025], bullets: [
- Engineered an end-to-end RPA ticketing suite controlling 50 concurrent accounts on Firefox with an IMAP-based auto-login pipeline for high-demand drops (Coldplay, Travis Scott, 2023 World Cup).
- Engineered custom Queue-IT bypass logic by optimizing request timing to consistently achieve sub 500 queue positions against 1M+ users.
- Deployed a centralized monitor to track live queue progression and seat availability across all active sessions.
])
#entry([Real-Time Copy Trading Bot (Solana + EVM)], [Jul 2024], bullets: [
- Built a real time copy trading system across Solana and EVM chains (Ethereum, Base), supporting multiple copier + copying wallets.
- Monitored on-chain transactions via RPC nodes, detected and decoded swap input data, and mirrored trades with configurable allocation executing within the next block.
])

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Skills]
#skillblock[
#strong[Automation:] API/Android Reverse Engineering, Puppeteer, Appium, SSL Proxying, Burp, Frida, Dify \
#strong[Frontend:] React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, React Native \
#strong[Backend & DB:] Node.js, Python, PHP, MySQL, Mongo \
#strong[Cloud & Infra:] GCP (Cloud Run), AWS, Serverless, Nginx, Linux
]

#v(12pt, weak: true)

#sectionhead[Education]
#entry([IPS Academy, Rajendra Nagar, Indore], [2023 --- 2027], description: [
Bachelor of Technology - BTech in Computer Science
])
